title_cyr: Денот ми дојде војник да одам
title_latin: Denot mi dojde vojnik da odam
title_en: The Day Has Come for Me to Go as a Soldier
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear. The last stanza reads as a plea not to leave him or take another lover (my reading); 'немој' means 'do not'.

lines.cyr: Денот ми дојде војник да одам,
lines.lat: Denot mi dojde vojnik da odam,
lines.en: The day has come for me to go as a soldier,
to go as a soldier, far away,
I can barely part, I leave my sorrows behind,

lines.cyr: мајко ле, не плачи, мајко ле, не жали.
lines.lat: majko le, ne plači, majko le, ne žali.
lines.en: mother, oh, do not cry, mother, oh, do not grieve.

lines.cyr: Другари ме чекаат, стара ле мајко,
lines.lat: Drugari me čekaat, stara le majko,
lines.en: My comrades are waiting for me, dear old mother,

lines.cyr: другари ме чекаат, чекаат и пеат,
lines.lat: drugari me čekaat, čekaat i peat,
lines.en: my comrades are waiting for me, waiting and singing,

lines.cyr: немој ле, мајко, солзи да рониш,
lines.lat: nemoj le, majko, solzi da roniš,
lines.en: do not, oh mother, shed tears,

lines.cyr: затрај се, не плачи, мајко ле, не жали.
lines.lat: zatraj se, ne plači, majko le, ne žali.
lines.en: hold on, do not cry, mother, oh, do not grieve.

lines.cyr: Не плачи мила, јас ќе се вратам,
lines.lat: Ne plači mila, jas ḱe se vratam,
lines.en: Do not cry, my dear, I will come back,

lines.cyr: јас ќе се вратам при тебе,
lines.lat: jas ḱe se vratam pri tebe,
lines.en: I will come back to you,

lines.cyr: немој ле, мила, мене да оставаш,
lines.lat: nemoj le, mila, mene da ostavaš,
lines.en: do not, oh my dear, leave me,

lines.cyr: друг да си заљубиш, за друг да отидеш.
lines.lat: drug da si zaljubiš, za drug da otideš.
lines.en: fall in love with another, go off to another.
